Note: Chart applies to round-trip economy flights booked through the CIBC Rewards Centre Opens a new window. or by calling 1-888-232-5656 Opens your phone app.. The exact number of Aventura Points required to purchase a flight depends on ticket prices set by airlines. A maximum ticket price (before taxes and other charges) applies for each destination; any excess cost over the maximum ticket price, plus taxes and other charges, must either be charged to your card or paid for with Aventura Points. Tickets are non-refundable. This chart may be changed without notice at any time. For complete details, refer to the Aventura Rewards Program Terms at the CIBC Rewards Centre. To obtain an Airline Travel Reward using the Aventura Airline Rewards Chart, you must redeem at least 80% of the total number of Aventura Points required to purchase it. If you don’t have enough Aventura Points to purchase an Airline Travel Reward in full (but have at least 80% of the required number of Aventura Points), you may have the Centre charge an amount to your Card to cover the Points Deficit, excluding Taxes and Other Charges. For a business class flight, you may have the Centre charge an amount to your Card to cover the Points Deficit for an economy class ticket in the same flight segment as the business class ticket you want, excluding Taxes and Other Charges. If you have the Centre charge an amount to your Card to cover the Points Deficit for an Airline Travel Reward and you are advised that the Aventura Travel Reward is refundable, then, in the event of a refund, the amount previously charged to your Card will not be refunded to your Credit Card Account and instead you will receive Aventura Points equal to the Points Deficit.

Protecting your card

Fraud alerts

We monitor fraud trends and typical debit and credit card activity. When we detect various factors that indicate a transaction may be fraudulent, we’ll notify you by text, email or phone to authenticate the transaction. To learn more, visit Fraud alerts.

Digital Disputes Platform

Have a transaction you don’t recognize? Contact us about it immediately by submitting a digital dispute. Simply sign on to your online or mobile banking, select the transaction you don’t recognize, select “Report an issue” and follow the instructions to submit your dispute.

Frequently asked questions

General travelⓘ 

With your Aventura Points, you can redeem directly for flights, hotels, and car rentals.

You can redeem your Aventura Points through the CIBC Rewards Centre (CIBC by Expediaⓘ) online or by calling 1-888-232-5656 Opens your phone app..

No. CIBC by Expediaⓘ and Expedia.ca are separate and distinct travel booking platforms. 

CIBC by Expedia is an exclusive platform for CIBC Cardholders that allows eligible clients to use Online Banking or Mobile Banking to easily book flights, hotels, car rentals, vacation packages, and more.

Yes. You can book travel three ways:

1. Using your Aventura credit card for the full purchase price;

• You will earn Aventura Points when booking on your Aventura credit card.

2. Using Aventura Points;

3. Using a combination of Aventura Points and your Aventura credit card.

• You will earn Aventura Points on the portion paid with your Aventura credit card.

No, there are no blackout dates or restrictions when booking through CIBC by Expediaⓘ.

No, your Aventura Points do not expireⓘ.

Flexible Travel Reward allows Aventura Cardholders to obtain travel through the CIBC Rewards Centre (CIBC by Expediaⓘ) with any combination of: 

  1. Aventura Points;
  2. Aventura Points and a charge to your Aventura credit card; or
  3. Charging the purchase directly to your Aventura credit card. 

Airline Rewards Chart

On the CIBC Rewards Centre (CIBC by Expedia), the Aventura Airline Rewards Chart displays the total number of points and cash required for a flight redemption using the Aventura Airline Rewards Chart, subject to a "maximum ticket price" for a round trip economy flight for one person in each travel region category. The maximum ticket price (before Taxes and Other Charges) is the base fare price. If the base fare price before Taxes and Other Charges exceeds the "maximum ticket price," you must either charge the excess to your Aventura credit card or you may redeem Aventura Points to pay the excess. If the base fare price before Taxes and Other Charges is less than the maximum ticket price, no credit (in either Aventura Points or a credit applied to your Aventura credit card) is granted. All taxes, fees, base fare price and maximum ticket prices are in Canadian dollars. The Aventura Business Class Airline Rewards Chart, open to CIBC Aventura Visa Infinite Privilege* cardholders, shows a "maximum ticket price" for a round trip business or first class flight for one person in each travel region category. If you don’t have enough Aventura Points to purchase an Airline Travel Reward in full (but have at least 80% of the required number of Aventura Points), you may ask the Centre to charge an amount to your Card to cover the Points Deficit. If you have the Centre charge an amount to your Card to cover the Points Deficit for an Airline Travel Reward and you are advised that the Aventura Travel Reward is refundable, then, in the event of a refund, the amount previously charged to your Card will not be refunded to your Credit Card Account and instead you will receive Aventura Points equal to the Points Deficit.
